title: Vulnerability of LLMs’ Belief Systems? LLMs Belief Resistance Check Through Strategic Persuasive Conversation Interventions

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating how inducing confirmation bias through system prompts affects the models' susceptibility to multi-turn persuasive conversations.
Measuring the models' belief robustness in detecting implicit hate speech and social bias using the LatentHatred dataset when subjected to persuasive counterfactual arguments.
